title: The same certificate bound holds for degree-two functions on perfect matchings
author: Gilad Chase; Neta Dafni; Yuval Filmus; Nathan Lindzey
work: Uniqueness for 2-Intersecting Families of Permutations and Perfect Matchings
difficulty_reason: Counted unit is the author's labelled lemma at source lines 490-492, the matching analogue of the permutation bound: for n at least eight, a function on perfect matchings of degree at most two has a common certificate of size at most n minus two. The proof (source lines 493-497) repeats the shape of the permutation case in the matching language: a supposed certificate of size n minus one leaves four independent alternatives, the values of f on the matchings obtained by choosing among them give a four-bit function, and the degree bound is carried over to it so that the same finite exclusion applies. The statement records the bound and neither the reduction nor the exclusion.
